sports.name: Basketball
sports.tagline: High-energy indoor court runs & full pickup games
sports.description: Indoor hardwood court with professional hoops. Perfect for fast-paced 5v5 scrimmages and shooting drills.

sports.name: Football
sports.description: High-quality synthetic turf arena under floodlights. Bring your turf boots for exciting 7v7 matches.

sports.name: Cricket
sports.tagline: Box cricket arena with tennis ball action
sports.description: Enclosed turf pitch designed for fast-paced box cricket, big hits, and friendly competitive office series.

sports.name: Badminton
sports.tagline: Synthetic indoor wooden courts & doubles rallies
sports.description: Professional BWF standard synthetic mat courts. Ideal for singles rallies and rotating doubles games.

sports.name: Squash
sports.description: Enclosed indoor 4-wall squash court with red boundary lines and wooden floors. Fast-paced rallies with small rubber squash ball.

sports.name: Pickleball
sports.tagline: Outdoor court with paddles & perforated wiffle balls
sports.description: Dedicated outdoor pickleball court with low net and kitchen line. Played with solid composite paddles and yellow perforated plastic balls.

sports.name: Volleyball
sports.description: Indoor cushioned court with standard net. High-energy bumps, sets, and spikes for all skill levels.
